desc: Derive exact ancestor and joint-ancestor probabilities for fixed vertices \(u,v\) in a random recursive tree, including endpoint and root cases.
Convert ancestry probabilities into expected edge contributions to the \(u\)-\(v\) distance.
Reorganize edge contributions into prefix sums for \(O(1)\) query processing.
Apply factorial scaling from expectations to sums over all \((N-1)!\) parent sequences.
Verify the implementation against all public sample tests.
